title: PML026 measured offline titer labels with past online sensor windows

source.title: Production and separation of a trehalolipid biosurfactant: data

task: Soft sensing: estimate the laboratory titer at hour t using only online sensors timestamped strictly before t. No laboratory titer or biochemical assay is an input.

window.aggregation: mean of actual sensor observations in [start,end)

split_guidance.reason: B2a and B2b are replicate fermentations; hold out both together when evaluating a new condition.
split_guidance.preferred: Three condition-group holdouts; all preprocessing is fit using the training conditions only. Report each fold and a macro average.
split_guidance.chronological_alternative: Within a batch, train through 240 h, tune on 264/288 h and test on 312/336/360 h; do not share any target or future sensor with earlier windows.
split_guidance.no_fixed_split: The file preserves groups and time; it does not silently choose the easiest split.

excluded_features: pH: B2b pH uses a separate sparse clock; omit from this common three-channel online extract
no_fill: No interpolation, backfill, forward fill, target duplication, zero fill or future observations. Missing hourly data would exclude that assay.
limitations: Four fermentations and three condition groups are small-sample evidence, even though minute sensor records are numerous.
This is ex-situ biosurfactant fermentation; it does not measure reservoir microbial activity or oil recovery.
Past-only refers to information timing, not causal identification of a process intervention.
